title: reply_to ON DELETE SET NULL silently modifies messages with no state counter advance
description: messages table: reply_to column has REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL. If a referenced message is deleted, reply_to silently becomes NULL — no state counter is advanced, no event is emitted, and Message/changes will not report the change. Client caches hold a stale replyTo that no longer exists in the store. Either prohibit message deletion (current stance) with an explicit constraint, or advance the state counter on SET NULL via a trigger.
